content_zh:
“家主令！”
“林玄修为尽废，有损族威，现废去世子之位，贬为庶人！”
“其所持传承宝物，即刻移交新任世子保管！”
东荒圣地。
天玄宗，外门广场。
一名白衣青年大声宣读来自家族的命令，正是林家新任世子，林天豪！
“林玄，我以新任世子身份命令你，立刻向我下跪，并交出那件传承宝物！”
“若敢抗命，杀无赦！”
林天豪对着林玄大声呵斥，目光狰狞。
对面之人，正是前任家主林剑锋的儿子——林玄！
一年前。
时任家主的林剑锋为了保护整个家族，在血冥谷死地硬扛数十名大敌围攻，至今下落不明。
一年后。
林天豪的父亲，大长老林牧洋伙同一干心腹，把持大权，自封家主。
上位后的第一把火，以血腥手段镇压林剑锋旧部。
第二把火，就烧到了林玄身上。
“好一个新任世子，好一群忘恩负义的畜生！！”
“林天豪！我把你当亲兄弟一样对待，帮助你修炼成长，你却辱我、害我，简直丧尽天良！”
林玄大声控诉，满腔怒火快要喷薄而出。
两人一起来到天玄宗修炼，他靠着强大天赋迅速崛起，成为外门第一天才！

在他不遗余力的帮助下，林天豪也是突飞猛进，与他并称外门双子星。
两兄弟并肩成长的事迹，一度传为佳话。
谁知人心叵测！
几天前外出寻宝，林天豪暴起偷袭将他重伤，独吞了宝物，实力大涨。
林玄因此修为尽废，被天玄宗贬为外门杂役，世子身份也被家族无情剥夺，现在又要夺走他手里那件东西。
“说完了吗？”面对这番控诉，林天豪深感不屑，冷笑嘲讽。
“武者靠的是实力，良心算什么东西？立刻交出那件传承宝物，否则死！”
林玄断然拒绝！
“那是我爹留给我的私人物品，不是什么传承宝物，我绝不会给你的！”
“胆敢违抗本世子的命令，你找死！”
嘭！
林天豪一脚踹飞了林玄。
激烈的场面，引来众多天玄宗弟子围观。
“曾经的林家世子、外门第一天才，竟然沦落到如此地步。”
“在他落难之际，林家没给他安慰和帮助，反而落井下石，真是可悲！”
“武者靠的是实力，一个废人，在那些高层眼里就是垃圾，更何况他还是前任家主的儿子，林天豪父子夺权上位，自然会把他视为眼中钉。”
此时的林玄，被踹得肋骨断裂，身躯如同虾子一样蜷缩起来，嘴里吐出的鲜血染红了地面。
“最后问你一次，交是不交？”林天豪眼中泛起寒光。
“呵呵！林师兄何必跟一个废物动怒，不就是一件宝物嘛，让我来吧！”
content_en:
"Family Head's Order!"
"Lin Xuanxiu's position has been completely abolished, which has damaged the prestige of the clan. He has now abolished his position as the son and demoted him to a commoner!"
"The inherited treasures he holds will be handed over to the new Crown Prince for safekeeping immediately!"
Eastern Wasteland Holy Land.
Tianxuanzong, outer gate square.
A young man in white loudly read the order from the family. It was Lin Tianhao, the new heir apparent of the Lin family!
"Lin Xuan, as the new crown prince, I order you to kneel down to me immediately and hand over the inherited treasure!"
"If you dare to disobey, you will be killed without mercy!"
Lin Tianhao yelled at Lin Xuan with a ferocious look.
The person opposite is none other than Lin Xuan, the son of the previous head of the family, Lin Jianfeng!
a year ago.
In order to protect the entire family, Lin Jianfeng, the head of the family at the time, endured the siege of dozens of enemies in Xue Ming Valley, and his whereabouts are still unknown.
One year later.
Lin Tianhao's father, the eldest elder Lin Muyang, together with his confidants, controlled the power and declared themselves the head of the family.
The first thing he did after taking office was to suppress Lin Jianfeng's old troops with bloody means.
The second fire burned Lin Xuan.
"What a new Crown Prince, what a bunch of ungrateful beasts!!"
"Lin Tianhao! I treat you like a brother and help you cultivate and grow, but you humiliate me and harm me. It's so unconscionable!"
Lin Xuan complained loudly, filled with anger that was about to burst out.
The two came to Tianxuan Sect to practice together, and he quickly rose with his powerful talent and became the number one genius in the outer sect!
With his untiring help, Lin Tianhao also made rapid progress, and he and he were called the Outer Geminis.
The story of the two brothers growing up side by side was once a legend.
Who knows that people's hearts are unpredictable!
A few days ago, when he went out to hunt for treasure, Lin Tianhao suddenly attacked him and seriously injured him. He swallowed the treasure and his strength greatly increased.
As a result, Lin Xuan's cultivation was completely ruined and he was demoted to an outside servant by Tianxuan Sect. His identity as the heir apparent was ruthlessly taken away from him by the family, and now they want to take away the thing in his hand.
"Are you done?" Faced with this accusation, Lin Tianhao felt deeply disdainful and sneered.
"A warrior relies on strength, what is conscience? Hand over that inherited treasure immediately, or die!"
Lin Xuan flatly refused!
"That's a personal item my father left to me. It's not an inherited treasure. I will never give it to you!"
"You dare to disobey my prince's orders, you are seeking death!"
Bang!
Lin Tianhao kicked Lin Xuan away.
The fierce scene attracted many Tianxuan Sect disciples to watch.
"The former eldest son of the Lin family and the number one genius in the outer sect has actually fallen to this level."
"When he was in trouble, the Lin family did not give him comfort and help, but instead added insult to injury. It's really sad!"
"A warrior relies on his strength. A useless person is trash in the eyes of those high-level officials. What's more, he is the son of the previous head of the family. Lin Tianhao and his son will naturally regard him as a thorn in their side when they seize power."
At this time, Lin Xuan was kicked so hard that his ribs were broken, his body curled up like a shrimp, and the blood spit out from his mouth dyed the ground red.
"Let me ask you one last time, do you want me to hand you over or not?" Lin Tianhao's eyes flashed with coldness.
"Haha! Why should Senior Brother Lin get angry with a loser? It's just a treasure. Let me do it!"
